name: Garlic-Parmesan Melting Cabbage
desc: Cabbage wedges seared deeply brown, then baked in a creamy garlic Parmesan broth until spoon-tender.

source.title: Melting Cabbage
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 (2 1/4 lb) head green cabbage, outermost leaves removed
Chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, for garnish (optional)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Halve the cabbage through the stem end, then cut each half into 4 wedges about 2 inches thick, keeping the core on each wedge.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large cast-iron or other heavy ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat. Add 4 wedges and cook until deeply browned on both sides, about 5 min per side. Move to a plate and sprinkle with 1/8 tsp each salt and pepper. Repeat with 1 tbsp oil, the remaining wedges and another 1/8 tsp each salt and pepper.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the remaining 2 tbsp oil, the onion, garlic, Italian seasoning and crushed red pepper and cook, stirring often, until the onion starts to soften and brown, 2 to 3 min.
Add the cream cheese and stir constantly until melted and creamy, about 1 min. Stir in the broth and the remaining 1/4 tsp each salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Stir the cornstarch and water together until smooth and whisk into the pan. Take the pan off the heat and whisk in 1/2 cup Parmesan until melted.
Return the wedges to the pan, overlapping if needed. Bake, turning once, until the cabbage is very soft and the sauce has reduced and thickened, about 50 min.
Let stand 5 min, then sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan and garnish with parsley.
tips: Keep the core on each wedge so it holds together.
